title: PhotoUploadV1
description: Metadata sent alongside the JPEG preview when uploading a photo from the LR plugin. Servers are tolerant readers: unknown optional fields are ignored, so newer clients keep working with older servers. New required fields need a new schema version.

lr_catalog_uuid.description: Lightroom Classic catalog UUID — stable identifier assigned by LR.

exif_snapshot.description: EXIF metadata snapshot (camera model, ISO, shutter speed, aperture, focal length, etc.).

lr_develop_settings.description: Current Lightroom Develop module settings at time of export (baseline for delta calculation).

lr_metadata.description: The photographer's decisions, used as culling labels. Re-uploading the same lr_catalog_uuid refreshes this together with lr_develop_settings and exif_snapshot.

color_label.description: Color label, e.g. red, yellow, green
